command: Decode original instructions at the pinned IDA addresses; reassemble with python verify.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig>. Run check-native-coverage.py NATIVE-350 --original <zedstwu.dll>. Run python -B s21/verify-copy.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig> from the submission directory to replay s21. Run python -B s25/verify-copy-high.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig> from the submission directory to replay s25. Run python -B s29/verify-avx-fill.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig> from the submission directory to replay s29. Run python -B s33/check-fill.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s33. Run python -B s37/check-query.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s37. Run python -B s41/check-initializer.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s41. Run python -B s45/check-cutoffs.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s45. Run python -B s49/check-diagnostic.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s49. Run python -B s53/check-message-source.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s53. Run python -B s57/check-format-source.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s57. Run python -B s61/replay.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s61. Run python -B s65/replay.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s65. Run python -B s69/replay.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s69. Run python -B s73/replay.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s73.
scope: Legacy entries, original entry point, exports, all runtime anchors and the additional direct branch target at RVA 0x180c0; two copy entries, 128 import thunks and version resource checked independently. Fifth-round evidence includes four reassembled business exports and a cross-DLL data symbol. Ninth-round evidence covers both called hosts, their complete text, direct branches, external calls and RIP operands. Thirteenth-round evidence checks the original calling edges, references and full text of two internal callees. Four dispatch entry/initializer ranges reassembled; both original initializer target sets verified. Three s21 ranges bound and byte-matched, including four computed jumps and three embedded relative-offset tables. The s25 high-capability copy body is byte-matched, with four computed jumps and three embedded relative-offset tables. s29 reassembles the AVX fill branch with four computed jumps and three embedded relative-offset tables. s33 reassembles the AVX-512 fill leaf and shared return with four computed transfers. s37 reassembles the capability query and its unwind entry and checks readiness, indexing, and the initializer target. s41 reassembles the CPUID initializer, initialized vendor and descriptor data,  loader-zeroed records, and the initializer unwind entry. s45 reassembles the cache cutoff writer, its exception directory entry and unwind information, initial cutoff storage and the debug environment key. s49 reassembles the diagnostic reporter and verifies its exception entry, two format strings, formatting buffer zero-fill and CRT import. s53 reassembles the message selector and verifies its exception entry, 62 fallback records and pointers, resource state and seven import call sites. s57 reassembles the resource-path varargs formatter and binds its format, buffer helper and cookie references. s61 reassembles RVA [0x18620,0x18679), .pdata and .xdata, and binds the scoped reference evidence. s65 reassembles the attach cleanup funclet, its unwind information and one tail transfer. s69 reassembles the detach cleanup funclet, its unwind information and one direct call. s73 reassembles two adjacent CRT cleanup fragments with unwind entries and three relocations.
limitations: 255 个入口中 160 个有覆盖、95 个缺口，3,567 条引用中 26 条未决。整件静态验收未通过。 External CRT and locale behavior remain for Windows comparison.
